title: Fridgeroo on Tour – Part 2: The freezer from hell
feature: freezer tracking (what is in the freezer and since when)

scenes.label: 🚨 ICE AGE FREEZER

caption: Part 2 of Fridgeroo on Tour 🧊 This pizza has been frozen since 2019. Fridgeroo tracks what's in your freezer and since when. Use it or lose it. fridgeroo.netlify.app 👇 What's the oldest thing in YOUR freezer?

newProps.iceblock: translucent cyan box (opacity ~0.38, cyan edge outline, rim light), pizza as fixed child at ~60% scale, big '2019' tag sprite on the front face (same font/colour as the app's 2019). Action iceslide {slideAt, crackAt}: door pops, block slides out to ~(0.55,0.31,0.85) with wobble + settle; at crackAt it shatters into <=12 cyan triangle shards (<1 s), the pizza drops onto a plate beside the freezer, freezer door swings shut with a neon glow. Preview slide + crack frames before the full render.

voiceText: [shouting, heroic] Freezer's got an iceberg. Move! [long pause] [deadpan, sarcastic] Pizza from 2019, Dad? [long pause] [slow, serious, to camera] YOU have one too. [long pause] [grudging, then warm] Fridgeroo knows how long it's been frozen.
